question: Who among the following helped Kaira District Co - operative Milk Producers' Union Ltd expand its work, ushering in the White Revolution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Verghese Kurien.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** White Revolution **is the achievement of **Kaira district milk producers and co-operative union** which owns and operates the** Amul dairy.**
 
• **Verghese Kurien** is renowned as **‘Milkman of India’ **and the** 'Father of the White Revolution'** of the **1970s.**
 
• Kurian joined hands with **Tribhuvandas Patel**, **founder of the Kaira dairy farmers’ union, **to turn the Kaira dairy movement into a nationwide cooperative called Anand Milk Producers Union Limited (AMPUL)
